title: uStudy 后端架构报告（2026-03-27）
content:
uStudy 后端架构

1. 系统全景

uStudy 后端是一个面向 AI 辅助学习场景的 FastAPI 单体服务，通过 SSE 流式传输向客户端推送 LLM 响应，并围绕知识图谱、向量记忆、间隔复习三条主线组织核心业务。

txt
@startuml 系统全景
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

actor "移动端 / H5\n(uni-app)" as Client
actor "管理员" as Admin

rectangle "uStudy Backend\n(FastAPI · 6 workers)" {
    component "API Layer\n(24 routers)" as API
    component "Auth" as AuthM
    component "Chat (SSE)" as ChatM
    component "Agents\n(异步任务)" as AgentsM
    component "Graph\n(知识图谱)" as GraphM
    component "RAG\n(文档检索)" as RAGM
    component "Memory\n(向量记忆)" as MemM
    component "Quizzes / Review\n(测验 · SM-2)" as QuizM
    component "Quota / Payment\n(配额 · 支付)" as BizM
    component "Notifications\n(pg_notify)" as NotifM
}

database "PostgreSQL\n+ pgvector" as PG
database "Redis" as Redis

cloud "OpenRouter API\n(LLM · Embedding)" as LLM
cloud "Tokyo Bridge\n(:8080 代理)" as Bridge
cloud "Alipay\n(支付宝)" as Alipay
cloud "Resend\n(邮件)" as Email
cloud "Crawl4AI / Jina\n(网页抓取)" as Crawl

Client --> API
Admin --> API
API --> AuthM
API --> ChatM
API --> AgentsM
API --> GraphM
API --> RAGM
API --> MemM
API --> QuizM
API --> BizM
API --> NotifM

ChatM --> PG
AgentsM --> PG
GraphM --> PG
RAGM --> PG
MemM --> PG
QuizM --> PG
BizM --> PG
NotifM --> PG

ChatM --> Redis
AgentsM --> LLM
ChatM --> LLM
RAGM --> LLM
MemM --> LLM
LLM <-- Bridge : 区域受限模型转发
BizM --> Alipay
AuthM --> Email
RAGM --> Crawl

@enduml

2. 模块总览

后端共 40+ 个功能模块，按职责分为六个域：

txt
@startuml 模块域划分
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA

package "身份认证域" {
    component "auth\n注册·登录·Apple·JWT·密码重置" as auth
    component "activation\n激活码兑换订阅" as activation
    component "upload\n头像·文件上传" as upload
}

package "会话与 AI 域" {
    component "chat\nSSE 流式对话·工具调用" as chat
    component "agents\n后台 AI 任务" as agents
    component "assessment\n短答题 AI 评分" as assessment
    component "attachments\n消息附件存储" as attachments
}

package "知识域" {
    component "graph\n知识图谱 CRUD·掌握度" as graph
    component "spaces\n学习空间管理·协作" as spaces
    component "documents\n文档库" as documents
    component "rag\n文档处理·混合检索" as rag
    component "memory\n向量语义记忆" as memory
    component "notes\n用户笔记·Artifacts" as notes
    component "folders\n嵌套文件夹" as folders
}

package "学习进度域" {
    component "quizzes\n测验生成·提交·评估" as quizzes
    component "review\nSM-2 间隔复习" as review
    component "activity\n学习活动日志" as activity
    component "calendar_events\n学习日历" as calendar_events
    component "search_settings\n搜索渠道偏好" as search_settings
}

package "商业化域" {
    component "quota\n配额管理·分级限制" as quota
    component "payment\n支付宝订单·订阅激活" as payment
    component "admin\n管理后台" as admin
    component "feedback\n用户反馈" as feedback
    component "usage\nAPI 用量记录" as usage
}

package "基础设施域" {
    component "notifications\npg_notify · SSE 推送" as notifications
    component "scheduler\nAPScheduler 定时任务" as scheduler
    component "core\nJWT · bcrypt · 审计日志" as core
    component "db\n连接池 · ORM 模型 · 迁移" as db
    component "crawler\n网页抓取 · SSRF 防护" as crawler
}
@enduml

3. 数据库架构（核心表）

数据库采用 PostgreSQL + pgvector，所有 ORM 模型集中在 db/models.py 单文件中（45+ 张表，1900+ 行）。

txt
@startuml 核心 ER 图
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
hide circle
skinparam linetype ortho

entity users {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    email
    password_hash
    apple_id
    subscription_tier : Enum(FREE/BASIC/PREMIUM/ALPHA/ULTRA)
    subscription_expires_at
    avatar_url
}

entity spaces {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK→users>>
    name
    is_collaborative : bool
    tool_mode : Enum(auto/manual)
    review_mode : 0-3
    enabled_tools : JSON
}

entity space_members {
    * space_id <<FK→spaces>>
    * user_id <<FK→users>>
    --
    role : Enum(owner/member)
    color
}

entity conversations {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK→users>>
    space_id <<FK→spaces>>
    title
    artifact_note_id <<FK→notes>>
}

entity messages {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    conversation_id <<FK>>
    role : Enum(user/assistant)
    content
    tool_calls : JSON
    citations : JSON
    llm_context : JSON
}

entity nodes {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    space_id <<FK>>
    label
    mastery : 0-100
}

entity edges {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    space_id <<FK>>
    from_node_id <<FK→nodes>>
    to_node_id <<FK→nodes>>
    type : Enum(knowledge_tree/learning_path/advanced)
    user_id <<nullable, 个人学习路径>>
}

entity node_user_mastery {
    * node_id <<FK→nodes>>
    * user_id <<FK→users>>
    --
    mastery : 0-100
}

entity space_documents {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    space_id <<FK>>
    doc_type : Enum(document/link)
    title
    original_filename
    file_size
}

entity document_chunks {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    document_id <<FK>>
    space_id <<FK>>
    chunk_index
    content
    embedding : vector(2000)
    content_tsv : tsvector
}

entity vector_memories {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK>>
    space_id <<nullable>>
    memory_type : Enum(long_term/space)
    content
    embedding : vector(2000)
}

entity quizzes {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    space_id <<FK>>
    title / topic / difficulty
    is_review_quiz : bool
}

entity questions {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    quiz_id <<FK>>
    question_type : Enum(single_choice/multiple_choice/true_false/short_answer)
    question_stem
    options : JSON
    correct_answer
}

entity quiz_attempts {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    quiz_id <<FK>>
    user_id <<FK>>
    status : Enum(in_progress/submitted/evaluated)
    score
    user_answers_raw : JSON
    question_results : JSON
}

entity agent_tasks {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK>>
    space_id <<FK>>
    task_type : Enum(GENERATE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH/GENERATE_QUIZ/EXPAND_NODE/...)
    status : Enum(PENDING/RUNNING/DONE/FAILED)
    input_data / output_data / error_message : JSON
}

entity review_schedules {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK>>
    activity_id <<FK>>
    node_label
    review_number
    scheduled_date
    ease_factor
    interval_days
}

entity payment_orders {
    * id : UUID <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK>>
    out_trade_no
    target_tier
    billing_cycle
    amount_cents
    status : Enum(pending/paid/rejected/expired)
    expires_at
}

entity refresh_tokens {
    * id <<PK>>
    --
    user_id <<FK>>
    token_hash
    device_info
    family_id
    expires_at
}

users ||--o{ spaces : owns
users ||--o{ space_members : member_of
spaces ||--o{ space_members : has_members
spaces ||--o{ conversations : context_of
conversations ||--o{ messages : contains
spaces ||--o{ nodes : contains
nodes ||--o{ edges : connects
nodes ||--o{ node_user_mastery : per_user_mastery
spaces ||--o{ space_documents : has
space_documents ||--o{ document_chunks : chunked_into
users ||--o{ vector_memories : stores
spaces ||--o{ quizzes : has
quizzes ||--o{ questions : contains
quizzes ||--o{ quiz_attempts : attempted_by
users ||--o{ agent_tasks : triggers
users ||--o{ review_schedules : scheduled_for
users ||--o{ payment_orders : places
users ||--o{ refresh_tokens : holds
@enduml

4. 数据库连接模式

txt
@startuml 会话工厂
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA

rectangle "AsyncEngine\n(pool_size=5, max_overflow=5\npool_recycle=30min)" as Engine

rectangle "AsyncSessionLocal\n(sessionmaker)" as Factory

rectangle "get_db()\nFastAPI Depends\n★ 自动提交 / 回滚" as GetDB
rectangle "get_scoped_session()\n上下文管理器\n★ 不自动提交，调用方负责 commit" as Scoped

rectangle "HTTP 路由处理器" as Router
rectangle "SSE 生成器\n后台任务\n工具执行器" as BG

Engine --> Factory
Factory --> GetDB
Factory --> Scoped
GetDB --> Router
Scoped --> BG
@enduml

部署计算：6 个 uvicorn worker，每个 worker pool_size=5 + max_overflow=5，最大连接数 = 6 × 10 = 60。

5. SSE 流式会话（三阶段模式）

chat 模块的 SSE 端点通过三阶段设计避免 DB 连接在流式推送期间被长期占用。

txt
@startuml SSE 三阶段
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
participant Client
participant "chat/router.py" as Router
participant "chat/service.py\nLLMOrchestrator" as Orchestrator
participant "Tool Executors" as Tools
database PostgreSQL as PG
database Redis

Client -> Router : POST /api/chat/conversations/{id}/messages

group Phase 1 — Prepare (with get_db())
    Router -> PG : 加载会话、校验权限、检查配额
    Router -> PG : 拉取记忆、图谱状态、待复习项
    Router -> Router : 构建系统提示词
end

group Phase 2 — Stream (no DB)
    Router -> Orchestrator : stream_response(context)
    loop 最多 10 轮工具调用
        Orchestrator -> LLM : SSE 流式请求
        LLM --> Orchestrator : token stream
        Orchestrator --> Client : text_delta / thinking_delta
        alt 有工具调用
            Orchestrator -> Tools : execute_tool()
            Tools -> PG : 短暂 get_scoped_session() 读写
            Tools --> Orchestrator : tool_result
            Orchestrator --> Client : tool_call event
        end
    end
    Orchestrator --> Client : done event
end

group Phase 3 — Save (with get_scoped_session())
    Router -> PG : 持久化消息 + llm_context
    Router -> Router : asyncio.create_task() 触发后台任务
    note right
        - MemoryExtractor
        - MasteryEvaluator
        - PathExpander
        - ActivityLogger
    end note
end

Router --> Client : SSE 关闭
@enduml

6. LLM 工具调用循环

LLMOrchestrator 驱动的工具调用循环是 chat 与 agents 模块的核心执行引擎。

txt
@startuml LLM 工具调用循环
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
start
:构建 system prompt + 历史消息;
repeat
    :调用 OpenRouter API (流式);
    :收集 tool_calls 或 text 输出;
    if (有 tool_calls?) then (yes)
        :并行执行各 Tool Executor;
        note right
            graph_tools / rag_tools
            memory_tools / note_tools
            artifact_tools / calendar_tools
        end note
        :将 tool_result 追加至消息列表;
    else (no / text only)
        :输出最终 assistant 内容;
        stop
    end if
repeat while (循环次数 < max_iter?) is (yes)
->no;
:返回 max iteration 截断提示;
stop
@enduml

max_iter 取值：Chat = 10，QuickChat = 5，MasteryEvaluator / PathExpander = 3。

7. 认证与令牌管理

txt
@startuml 认证流程
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
participant Client
participant "auth/router" as Auth
database PostgreSQL as PG

== 登录 ==
Client -> Auth : POST /api/auth/login (email + password)
Auth -> PG : 查询用户，验证 bcrypt 哈希
Auth -> PG : 创建 RefreshToken (SHA-256 存储, family_id)
Auth --> Client : { access_token (15min), refresh_token (30d) }

== 令牌刷新 ==
Client -> Auth : POST /api/auth/refresh (refresh_token)
Auth -> PG : 查找 token_hash，检查 family 是否已撤销
alt token 有效
    Auth -> PG : 旧 token 标记撤销，创建新 token (同 family)
    Auth --> Client : 新 access_token + 新 refresh_token
else token 已被重用 (检测到复用)
    Auth -> PG : 撤销整个 family 所有 token
    Auth --> Client : 401 Unauthorized
end

== 保护路由 ==
Client -> Auth : 任意请求 (Bearer token)
Auth -> Auth : decode_token() 验证 HS256 签名 + 到期时间
Auth -> PG : 加载用户 + get_effective_tier()
@enduml

设备限制：每用户最多 N 个并发设备（默认可配），超出时最旧令牌自动失效。

8. 异步 Agent 任务模式

txt
@startuml Agent 任务模式
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
participant Client
participant "agents/router" as Router
database PostgreSQL as PG
participant "AgentTask\n后台协程" as Task
participant "LLM" as LLM

Client -> Router : POST /api/agents/tasks/{type}
Router -> PG : 创建 AgentTask (status=PENDING)
Router -> Router : asyncio.create_task(run_agent())
Router --> Client : 202 Accepted { task_id }

loop 后台执行
    Task -> PG : 更新 status=RUNNING
    Task -> LLM : 多轮 LLM 调用（视任务类型）
    Task -> PG : 写入产出（节点/边/题目/代码）
    Task -> PG : 更新 status=DONE / FAILED
end

Client -> Router : GET /api/agents/tasks/{task_id}
Router -> PG : 查询 AgentTask 状态 + output_data
Router --> Client : { status, output }
@enduml

任务类型：GENERATE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH、GENERATE_QUIZ、EXPAND_NODE、GENERATE_ARTIFACT、GENERATE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_FROM_DOCUMENTS、GENERATE_REVIEW_QUIZ。

9. RAG 文档处理管线

txt
@startuml RAG 管线
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
participant Client
participant "documents/\nrag/router" as Docs
database PostgreSQL as PG
participant "DocumentProcessor\n(后台任务)" as Proc
participant "OpenRouter\nEmbedding API" as Embed

Client -> Docs : POST /api/documents/spaces/{id} (上传文件 / URL)
Docs -> PG : 创建 SpaceDocument (status=processing)
Docs -> Proc : asyncio.create_task()

group 文档处理
    Proc -> Proc : 解析格式 (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/CSV/MD/HTML/EPUB/TXT)
    Proc -> Proc : 分块 (600 tokens 目标, 100 重叠, 50 最小)
    Proc -> Embed : 批量生成 embedding (qwen3-embedding-8b, 2000 维)
    Proc -> PG : 写入 DocumentChunk\n(content + embedding + content_tsv)
    alt 含视觉内容
        Proc -> LLM : VLM 图片描述 / OCR
    end
end

Proc -> PG : 更新 SpaceDocument status=ready

Client -> Docs : POST /api/rag/spaces/{id}/search
Docs -> PG : 向量相似度搜索 + BM25 全文搜索
Docs -> Docs : RRF 融合排名
Docs -> LLM : 可选 Cross-Encoder 重排
Docs --> Client : 检索结果列表
@enduml

10. 间隔复习（SM-2）调度

txt
@startuml SM-2 调度
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
participant "对话 / 测验\n完成事件" as Trigger
participant "review/service" as SM2
database PostgreSQL as PG

Trigger -> SM2 : schedule_review_generation(activity_id, study_depth)
SM2 -> PG : 创建 ReviewSchedule\n(interval 由 study_depth 初始化)

...待复习日到来...

participant Client
Client -> SM2 : GET /api/review/due
SM2 -> PG : 查询 scheduled_date <= today (去重 by activity_id)
SM2 --> Client : 待复习项列表

Client -> SM2 : POST /api/review/complete { quality: 0-5 }
SM2 -> SM2 : sm2_next_review()\n- quality < 3 → 重置 review_number\n- quality >= 3 → 递增 interval * ease_factor\n- ease_factor ∈ [1.3, 5.0]
SM2 -> PG : 创建下一条 ReviewSchedule
note right : 10+ 次 quality >= 4 → 停止调度（毕业）
@enduml

11. 通知系统（pg_notify）

txt
@startuml 通知系统
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
participant "后台任务\n(quiz 评估完成等)" as BG
database PostgreSQL as PG
participant "lifespan\nPgNotifyListener" as Listener
participant Client

BG -> PG : NOTIFY userstudy_notifications, '{"user_id":...}'
PG --> Listener : 触发 listener 回调
Listener -> PG : 写入 Notification 记录
Listener -> Listener : 推送到该 user 的 SSE 连接队列

Client -> Listener : GET /api/notifications/stream (SSE 长连接)
Listener --> Client : SSE 事件（notification 类型）
Client -> PG : PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read
@enduml

12. 配额分级规则

Tier 每日消息 最大空间数 存储/空间
FREE 20 条 1 30 MB
BASIC 150 条 5 300 MB
PREMIUM 无限 无限 2 GB
ALPHA 无限 无限 2 GB
ULTRA 无限 无限 2 GB

有效 Tier 在查询时实时计算（get_effective_tier()），订阅到期后无需 cron 任务，自动降级为 FREE。

14. 外部服务依赖汇总

服务 用途 接入方式
OpenRouter API LLM 推理 + 文本 Embedding HTTP / SSE
Tokyo Bridge (8.211.149.4:8080) 区域受限模型代理（Gemini 等） HTTP 透明转发
PostgreSQL + pgvector 关系数据 + 向量索引（HNSW） asyncpg
Redis 流式 Artifact 缓存状态 aioredis
Resend 邮件验证码 + 通知 HTTP API
Alipay 支付宝订单 alipay-sdk-python
Crawl4AI JS 重型网页渲染抓取 Docker 服务 HTTP
Jina Reader 网页内容提取（备用） HTTP API
SearXNG 元搜索引擎（自托管，可选） HTTP
OpenAI Whisper 视频音频转录 HTTP API
APScheduler 进程内定时任务（复习提醒、清理过期订单） 内嵌，无外部依赖

15. 部署拓扑

txt
@startuml 部署拓扑
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA

node "HK Server\n47.76.51.198" {
    component "Nginx" as Nginx
    component "FastAPI\n6 uvicorn workers" as App
    database "PostgreSQL\n+ pgvector" as DB
    database "Redis" as Redis
    folder "/var/www/ustudy-web\n/var/www/ustudy-app\n/uploads\n/static/payment" as Static
}

node "Tokyo Server\n8.211.149.4" {
    component "OpenRouter Bridge\n:8080" as Bridge
}

cloud "OpenRouter\nAPI" as OR

actor "用户 (Mobile/H5)" as User
actor "管理员" as Admin

User --> Nginx : api.ustudy.top (HTTPS)
User --> Nginx : app.ustudy.top (H5 静态)
Admin --> Nginx : api.ustudy.top/admin

Nginx --> App : proxy_pass :8000
App --> DB
App --> Redis
App --> Bridge : 区域受限模型
Bridge --> OR
App --> OR : 普通模型直连
@enduml
